_source: Measured off the M_Light primitive of each kit .gltf - the emissive strip is the lamp, so the lamp is seeded on the face of the strip and pointed the way the strip faces.
_note: A SEED, not a derivation. These fire once, when a module is first placed; from then on the light belongs to that element, so an edit survives a save and a copy carries it. Changing this file never touches a ship that is already laid out.
_axes: Editor space. Babylon's glTF loader turns the file 180 degrees about Y and mirrors Z, which nets out to x_editor = -x_gltf, so the strip centres below are the .gltf values with X negated. A lamp shines along its own local -Y.

modules._Modular SciFi MegaKit/Props/Prop_Light_: A quarter-circle strip, centre [0.083, -0.08], radius 3.889, sweeping -87 to -2 degrees. One lamp cannot light the whole arc evenly, so the strip is served by three, spaced along it; the rotations are the tangent at each segment's midpoint.
The only one that does not point down: its face is tilted 18 degrees off vertical, so it is turned 161.6 degrees about X to throw the light up the wall instead of at the floor it is standing on.
